name: ModelCommitTarget
documentation: Persistence and lifecycle effects of one original event on one independently stored model.

fields.name: aliases
fields.documentation:
Complete desired aliases of the resulting model state.

A {@code null} value denotes a client which does not manage independent-model aliases. An empty list explicitly removes every current alias. The runtime applies this replacement atomically with the model transition.

fields.name: cascadeDelete
fields.documentation:
Whether the runtime must verify that every current child relationship owned by this target is represented by a deletion target in the same atomic commit.

This remains false for older clients, preserving their existing detach-on-parent-deletion behavior.

fields.name: delete
fields.documentation: Whether the updated current state is a logical deletion.

fields.name: document
fields.documentation:
Optional direct current-document mutation produced by this transition.

The runtime applies it with the same assigned state index as this target. A missing mutation means that the model is not directly searchable; a mutation with a {@code null} document means delete.

fields.name: expectedSequenceNumber
fields.documentation:
Sequence number observed immediately before this transition, or {@code -1} when the model did not exist.

A {@code null} value omits the target-level sequence assertion, for example for a target that publishes an effect without reading or changing model state. The runtime can use an explicit {@code -1} to avoid a point read for an independent create on the default single-writer path.

fields.name: modelId
fields.documentation: Exact persisted identity, equal to the model ID's {@code toString()} value.

fields.name: modelType
fields.documentation:
Stable serialized model type descriptor. A model's first commit that creates its durable head must provide this value; later commits may omit it and inherit the durable type.

This is coordination metadata for untyped and graph loads; it is not part of model identity.

fields.name: relationships
fields.documentation:
Complete desired outgoing parent relationships when {@link #updateRelationships} is true.

The runtime reconciles these against its actual current relationships; they are not blindly applied as client-calculated previous/current deltas. The list is empty when relationships are not updated.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.documentation:
Optional snapshot value produced when this transition is predicted to reach the model's configured snapshot
 period. The runtime verifies the candidate against its assigned target sequence before storing it.

fields.name: storeEvent
fields.documentation: Whether the substep event receives a membership in this model's stream.

fields.name: updateRelationships
fields.documentation:
Whether {@link #relationships} intentionally replaces the model's outgoing parent relationships.

A regular transition whose {@code @Parent} values did not change leaves this false. This prevents such a transition from reopening relationships which the runtime closed because a parent was deleted. Logical model deletion always sets this to true.

fields.name: updateState
fields.documentation:
Whether the returned model state becomes the current logical state.

This may be true while {@link #storeEvent} is false for an explicitly non-stored state transition. The runtime then marks the model's event history incomplete.
